title: Privileged account assignment and removal need monitoring evidence
remediation: The deployment identity owner approves the role-based or attribute-based scheme and the authorities who assign privileged accounts. Account operators inventory applicable privileged assignments and monitor changes. Collect redacted configuration, sampled approved assignments, change-monitoring records and timely revocation evidence. Verify that a removed assignment cannot use the privileged action.

milestones.title: Collect approved privileged account inventory, role or attribute change monitoring, and denial after revocation
Where assigned staff positions are deployed, verify scoped signed handover records and refusal of the former holder's decision
